title: OrderIntent
description: Workflow→exec-svc request to place a paper or live broker order. Generated by CopytradeSignalWorkflow after risk+contract gates pass and consumed by ExecActivities.placeOrder on the broker-<env> task queue. intent_key drives the 3-layer idempotency model (plan line 362).

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. Workers reject newer-than-build inputs to force redeploy.

intent_key.description: Deterministic idempotency key shared with broker client_order_id. Shape: '<workflow_id>:entry' or '<workflow_id>:exit:<exit_signal_id>'.

signal_id.description: Source Discord signal_id (correlates to CopytradeSignalPayload.signal_id and the audit-log correlation_id).

broker_target.description: Routes the activity to the broker-paper or broker-live task queue. Phase 2b only handles 'paper'.

side.description: BUY=BTO; SELL=STC. Phase 2b only exercises BUY.

limit_price.description: Optional limit. Omitted (null) means marketable-mid. Phase 2b passes payload.price.

recorded_at.description: Workflow's view of when the intent was minted (UTC).
